
# CKAD v1.0.0 — Complete Study Guide

## What’s included

- Complete CKAD-focused learning path across the five official domains
- Guidance aligned with the Kubernetes/CKAD baseline documented in this release
- Hands-on labs and progressive troubleshooting practice
- CKAD Command Mastery reference
- End-to-end worked example
- Reference cheat sheets
- Three full CKAD-style mock exams with 17 tasks each
- Study plan and exam-readiness guidance
- Kubernetes architecture and YAML companion references

## Quality / validation

- Markdown and fenced sections reviewed
- YAML examples reviewed for structural consistency
- Mock A/B/C task counts validated
- CKAD terminology and priority labels reviewed
- Unsupported "real exam" claims removed

## Scope note

This is a CKAD preparation resource, not an official CNCF/Linux Foundation course or exam question bank.

Practice tasks are CKAD-style and are not claimed to be leaked or guaranteed live-exam questions.

## Baseline

This release is aligned with the Kubernetes/CKAD baseline documented for the release, with Kubernetes v1.35 as the reference baseline.

## Recommended use

1. Learn the concept
2. Complete the chapter lab
3. Practice with the command/reference material
4. Repeat troubleshooting drills
5. Run the timed labs
6. Complete the three full mock exams

## Changes in this release

- CKAD study path aligned with the current Kubernetes v1.35 baseline used for this release
- Five-domain curriculum coverage with exam-priority guidance
- Hands-on labs across configuration, deployment, networking, observability, and troubleshooting
- CKAD command-mastery and YAML reference material
- End-to-end worked example combining multiple Kubernetes concepts
- Three 17-task CKAD-style mock exams
- Timed practice and exam-readiness guidance
- Kubernetes architecture and YAML companion references
- Technical review and consistency pass across the repository
